releases.changelog:
# New features
- Live 3D car preview
- Custom skin preview generation via CM
- Notifications for newer apps versions and recommended CSP versions
# Reworked skin application
- Multi-frame progressive pipeline: skins queued and applied over time for stable FPS
- Full ext-config (shader replacement support) (all locations, correct order, skin filtering)
- Per-LOD support for textures and shader replacements
- Materials made unique before apply to prevent cross-car skin changes
- Reduced RAM: original car shaders fetched on demand instead of cached at startup
- Remote skins apply a bit slower for more stable fps online; user skins apply faster
# UI
- New app menu that fades with the window (Patreon icon moved here)
- Customizable fade behavior with separate settings for driving and replay
- Full fade above 5 km/h (skips app render while driving)
- Skin grid: first icon is 'no skin', second is the original skin (shown as '?' when missing locally)
- Some skin-icon draw perf improvements
# QoL
- Skin info collection async at startup
- Live skin reload when files change on disk (textures + ext_configs, within what's supported)
- CM-generated previews moved from car folder into the app folder
- Log file rotation (keeps last 10)
- Async log writes (off main thread)
# Fixes
- Fixed default skin not applying properly online and other known bugs like skin not ressetting properly or changing on multiple cars
# Known issues
- CM occasionally fails to refocus AC after preview generation (click back manually if it happens)
- Live preview framing assumes car is on the ground; switching to a mid-air car in replays may cause a weird preview
- Shader replacements can take a bit long to apply (maybe up to 3 ms in some cases) (planned fix for next release)
- Driver head missing from the preview in some F1 camera modes
- Preview forces highest LOD for the selected car; may interfere with LOD-tweaking tools
# CSP compatibility
- Recommended: 0.3.0-preview440+ (independent reflections in preview)
- Minimum with new pipeline: 0.3.0-preview110
- Absolute minimum: 0.2.11 (backward-compat legacy path; missing most new features; will be dropped next release)

# Replays
- Skin changes are now recorded in replays and played back (replays recorded with 2.1.0 or later)
- Manual skin override mode for replays, saved across game reloads (tied to the replay file name)
- Button to toggle between synced and overridden skins
# Online
- Skin changes can be held under some conditions: disabled by the server, car moving, or car taking part in a race
- Held changes are applied automatically once allowed
- Other drivers' skins are still applied when you join, even if they're already driving
- Server owners can disable skin changes with [SKIN_COMPANION] DISABLE_SKIN_CHANGES = 1 in the CSP extra options
# Performance
- Async shader replacements: shader compilation no longer happens on the main thread (CSP 0.3.0-preview728+, can be turned off in settings)
- Skin changes run within a ~1 ms budget per frame, and are much faster
- Less garbage generated by the app, especially while its window is open
# UI
- The main window can be used while the settings window is open
- No more 1 s delay between skin selections, and clicks can queue another skin
- Tooltip explaining why a skin change is blocked
- New Skin tools tab in settings
# Fixes
- Search bars no longer break on ( [ or %
- Skinned mesh textures (driver gloves for example) now reset properly
# Changes
- Re-applying skins when files change is now a setting (off by default)
- Legacy skin pipeline removed: minimum CSP is now 0.3.0-preview11
- More logging and a replay debug tab
